title: Mechanism of Interaction Between the Transactivation Domain of N-MYC and the DNA-Binding Surface of TFIIIC5
authors: Eoin Leen; Sharon Yeoh; Eka Sahak; Ellie Mitchell; Gemma Wildsmith; Matthew Batchelor; Antonio N Calabrese; Gabriele Büchel; Richard Bayliss
one_liner_zh: 该文通过NMR、HDX质谱和AlphaFold建模研究N-MYC转录激活域与TFIIIC5 DNA结合界面的互作机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作体系，方法含AI结构预测，但非典型TF-DNA结合位点预测或动态模拟，故评7分。
abstract: N-myc is a member of the myc family of transcription factors, which are powerful drivers of cellular growth and consequently, important oncoproteins. N-myc interacts with many factors and complexes to affect transcription. One such complex is the RNA Polymerase III assembly factor, TFIIIC, a six-member complex that is essential for the transcription of small, structured RNA. TFIIIC and N-myc mutually restrict each other’s chromatin association, and their complex contributes to quality control in mRNA transcription. We previously demonstrated that the largely intrinsically disordered transactivation domain of N-myc interacts directly with a sub-complex of TFIIIC, τA. Structural studies by others show that DNA binding of τA is largely mediated by TFIIIC3, which suggests that TFIIIC5 is at most a secondary binding site for DNA. Here we identified the DNA binding domain of TFIIIC5 as a key binding site for N-myc. We used an integrated approach combining NMR, HDX mass spectrometry, pull-downs and biophysical assays to elucidate the molecular basis of the interaction. Two sequences in the transactivation domain of N-myc bind to the DNA binding interface of TFIIIC5. AlphaFold modelling predicts a high-confidence binding mode for the higher affinity N-myc motif that overlaps with the predicted intramolecular binding site of the C-terminal acidic plug of TFIIIC5, removal of which enhances the binding of N-myc. The same two motifs in N-myc also interact with Aurora-A kinase, which competes with N-myc for TFIIIC binding during S-phase. This model elucidates how the N-myc:TFIIIC5 interaction competes with other interactions, providing a basis for their mutual censoring function and regulation. GRAPHICAL ABSTRACT
abstract_zh: N-myc是myc转录因子家族的一员，该家族是细胞生长的强力驱动因子，因此也是重要的癌蛋白。N-myc与多种因子和复合物相互作用以影响转录。其中一个复合物是RNA聚合酶III组装因子TFIIIC，这是一个六亚基复合物，对小型结构化RNA的转录至关重要。TFIIIC和N-myc相互限制彼此在染色质上的结合，它们的复合物有助于mRNA转录的质量控制。我们先前证明，N-myc的 largely 内在无序的转录激活结构域直接与TFIIIC的一个亚复合物τA相互作用。他人的结构研究表明，τA的DNA结合主要由TFIIIC3介导，这提示TFIIIC5至多是DNA的次要结合位点。在此，我们确定了TFIIIC5的DNA结合结构域是N-myc的关键结合位点。我们采用结合NMR、HDX质谱、pull-down和生物物理测定的综合方法，阐明了该相互作用的分子基础。N-myc转录激活结构域中的两个序列与TFIIIC5的DNA结合界面结合。AlphaFold建模预测了高亲和力N-myc基序的高置信度结合模式，该模式与TFIIIC5 C端酸性插头的预测分子内结合位点重叠，去除该插头可增强N-myc的结合。N-myc中的相同两个基序也与Aurora-A激酶相互作用，该激酶在S期与N-myc竞争TFIIIC结合。该模型阐明了N-myc:TFIIIC5相互作用如何与其他相互作用竞争，为其相互审查功能和调控提供了基础。图形摘要
